nom: PEACH & LILY Peptide Pro Firming Moisturizer

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the moisturizer does not make them greasier and can be used sparingly, spot-applied, or reserved for colder months when their skin runs drier.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including those in dry climates, describe it as rich enough to fight dryness while still absorbing without heaviness or greasiness.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers say it balances their skin without causing oiliness in the T-zone or dryness elsewhere, and several apply it only away from the oily zone.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive and fragrance/allergy-prone reviewers report it is gentle, non-irritating, and fragrance-free or very lightly scented, with no reactions noted.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers (40s to 60s) most consistently report firming, smoothing of fine lines and wrinkles, and a plumper, more hydrated look, though a few say it is too early to judge results.
segments.normal: Reviewers describing normal skin find it hydrating and non-heavy, with no oiliness left behind.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report visible softening of fine lines, wrinkles, and firmer-looking skin, especially around the eyes and neck, though several add they have used it too briefly to judge anti-aging results and one is unsure it does anything for wrinkles at all.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority describe strong, non-greasy hydration and plumper skin, including in dry climates and winter; this is the most consistently praised effect.
concerns.redness: A couple of reviewers say it calms redness and irritation, including one who otherwise had mixed results overall.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer credits it with visibly improving skin barrier condition when paired with a matching serum.
concerns.spots: One reviewer using it for weight-loss-related loose skin reports improvement in that specific area rather than for spots generally.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report no breakouts and some say it does not clog pores or cause milia, but a distinct minority describe new deep, painful cystic acne or clogging bumps that led them to stop use.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers repeatedly note the product absorbs without oily or greasy residue, including those with oily or combination skin.

aspects.libelle: Causes clogged pores or cystic breakouts
Slow shipping and poor customer service

extraits.texte: This moisturizer gives me the worst deep cystic acne. Something I've never dealt with. I thought maybe my skin was just changing so I stopped using for about 6 months. The acne went away and I tried again recently, but it gave me the same painful pimples.

extraits.titre: Really wanted to like it,  but....
extraits.texte: Had such high hopes for this moisturizer, however I wouldn't buy it again. Been using it for around a month now, and wanted so much for this to be my go-to, clean ingredients product. It IS very moisturizing, I won't deny them that, and seems to calm any redness I tend to get. But I've been noticing little bumps all over my face, like it's clogging my pores. And I honestly don't see much of a firming effect. I've had better results from multiple other brands in the same price point or cheaper, and that's really why I wouldn't purchase again.

I'm closer to 40 than 30 with combo skin, cystic acne once a month, and also fine lines - jackpot of bad things. This stuff is amazing. Two months and it's evened my skin out, I don't get volcanos impersonating zits, and I look closer to 30 than 40.

extraits.titre: So good you don't need much else
extraits.texte: I'm 38 with dry skin, living in a dry climate. I've been using a separate retinol serum for my 11 lines & smile lines for a couple of years. After using this cream for a couple of weeks, I ran out of the serum & realized I didn't need to reorder. This peptide cream has my skin looking the best it has in years: healthy, smooth, luminous & blemish-free. It's a definite repurchase & will be part of my essentials from now on, in spite of the price-point being higher than my usual moisturizer - it's that good!

I have very dry and VERY sensitive skin. I love this moisturizer at night because it does a great job hydrating while not irritating my skin. This is probably my 5th or 6th repurchase and I will continue to repurchase it! I also used to use the matcha moisturizer but switched to just this one since it's more hydrating. This also smells divine. (The matcha one is also great if you're looking for a lighter moisturizer, but this one isn't even that thick)

I got this during the last sale but will probably repurchase at the normal price. I really like it! Pros - Great for my dry sensitive skin - Moisturizes while not leaving my skin tacky or greasy - Unscented (I don't want fragrance or essential oils on my face) - Did NOT break me out like most other creams!! Cons - I prefer tubes to jars that you have to scoop the product out of - I feel like it's a bit expensive - but the only other product I've used that I liked this much was way more expensive so I will likely repurchase

I have been using this moisturizer for about 2 years now and cannot live without it! I am 64 years old and really trying to keep my skin looking and feeling as healthy as possible. This product is part of my daily routine. It keeps my skin soft, hydrated, and reduces the wrinkles (especially my turkey neck. . . ) considerably. Wonderful product at a super price!
